message.content: {"question":"A simple pendulum used to measure time is made of a mass attached to the end of a steel wire. The period of the pendulum correctly shows 1 s when the temperature is 0 C. Calculate how much time the clock will lose or gain in 1 day in a hot country where the average temperature is 40 C? (The linear expansion coefficient of steel is equal to 1.6·10⁻⁵ C⁻¹)","options":{"A":"The pendulum lags by 20 s per day","B":"The pendulum lags by 2.0 s per day","C":"The pendulum lags by 10 s per day","D":"The pendulum lags by 1.0 s per day"},"correct":null}
